# procedural input is reproduced bit-for-bit by the Rust test, so no input
# vectors are stored.
# SHAPE in_w in_h out_w out_h -> out_w*out_h hex f32 bits per plane, planes
#   0,1,2 in order. Plane 0 is ALL NEGATIVE on purpose: that is the case that

# HASH  in_w in_h out_w out_h -> one FNV-1a 64 digest of the same bit stream,
#   for shapes too large to store literally (the repo forbids large files).
